attributes.board_name: Arkansas State Board of Physical Therapy (Arkansas Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved programs and college courses in clinical application, clinical management, behavioral science, science or scientific research. Live interactive webinars count as in-person. Published article/research within the cycle: up to half of the requirement on Board approval. Supervising CAPTE PT/PTA students or residency/fellowship mentoring: 1 contact hour per 40 hours, max 5 hours for a PT.
rules.audit_note: At each odd-year renewal licensees attest under oath; after renewal 10% are randomly audited and have 20 days to submit proof (Board can pull CE from CE Broker on request). Keep proof 4 years.

topics.who: Passing the Board's online jurisprudence exam (20 questions, 70%) for every odd-year renewal; counts as 1 online CE hour

rules.legal_basis: Arkansas Physical Therapy Practice Act and Rules of the Arkansas State Board of Physical Therapy
rules.notes: 2 CEUs = 20 contact hours (1 CEU = 10 contact hours; a contact hour = actual time in a seminar or workshop). Hours must be earned in the 24 months before the odd-year renewal and completed by December 31 of the preceding even year; otherwise $50 per month penalty until completed. Licenses renew annually by March 1; CE is checked at odd-year renewals. Online CE max 50%.
rules.rule_quote: According to the Arkansas Physical Therapy Practice Act, physical therapists must complete, in each biennium (two-year period), two (2) CEUs (20 hours) and physical therapist assistants are required to complete, in each biennium, one (1) CEU (10 hours).

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same as PT; student/residency supervision credit max 2.5 hours for a PTA.
rules.audit_note: Attestation at odd-year renewal; 10% random audit, 20 days to submit proof. Keep proof 4 years.

topics.who: Board jurisprudence exam for every odd-year renewal; counts as 1 online CE hour

rules.legal_basis: Arkansas Physical Therapy Practice Act and Rules of the Arkansas State Board of Physical Therapy
rules.notes: 1 CEU = 10 contact hours. Earned in the 24 months before the odd-year renewal, completed by December 31 of the preceding even year ($50/month penalty otherwise). Annual renewal by March 1. Online CE max 50%.
